status: candidate frozen references; derived by two exact formulations that agree, not yet independently refuted
theory: small-displacement linear-elastic space frame; Euler-Bernoulli, or Timoshenko with the energy-matched annular shear factor; a member with DEC-045 stiffness scale s has stiffness s K; the reducer's body is the straight member between the two end centerlines

conventions.support_reaction: global action of the support on the structure at its node (moments about that node)
conventions.section_action: member-axis action on the +x face of the i-side portion at station s/L (x from `from` to `to`, y the y_reference less its x part, z = x cross y); a node-on-element end action is -section(0) at end_i and +section(1) at end_j

criterion: |observed - expected| <= 1e-9 * |expected|; an exactly zero expectation uses 1e-9 * zero_scale of its family (largest nonzero magnitude of that family in the case, or the case's stated fallback)
